Variants.Content: Yunkai is located on the east coast of Slaver's Bay, north of Astapor and south of Meereen, and is famous for its yellow brick walls and slave trade. The wise masters relied on slave manors, caravans and ports to accumulate wealth; after the arrival of Daenerys, the conflict between the old order and the liberating forces in the city made Yunkai an unavoidable node in the politics of Slaver's Bay.
Entry Yunkai Local families also rely on water, roads, arable land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Yunkai They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the known world; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.

Entry Yunkai If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Yunkai A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Yunkai They care about water sources, roads, cultivated land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
